sourceChanges.citationTitle: Newspaper Clippings Archive - Central Library, IIT Delhi
On the use of Generative AI at IIT Delhi

claimChanges.claimText: IIT Delhi's GenAI guidelines call for full disclosure of any work or content generated with the assistance of GenAI tools, including noting AI-created images, tables, data visualizations, or significant text sections.
The guidelines state that authors remain fully responsible for verifying the accuracy of AI-assisted work, rigorously fact-checking it and proactively confirming it is free from plagiarism.
The guidelines direct all users to exercise caution when entering data into GenAI tools and to screen out sensitive or private details before use.

IIT Delhi's committee holds that outright restriction of GenAI tools is neither enforceable nor desirable and recommends that each course instructor develop their own plagiarism policy governing AI use.
Course-level plagiarism policies are expected to set differentiated consequences for AI misuse while rewarding honest, responsible engagement with AI tools.
The committee recommends that IIT Delhi acquire institute-wide licenses for paid GenAI tools such as ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot to ensure equitable access.
Academic Units are advised to reevaluate assessment methods, prioritizing approaches that AI tools cannot easily replicate.

IIT Delhi's official Central Library archive lists a May 1-31, 2025 NewsClips PDF at lib.iitd.ac.in; this run did not stage substantive AI-policy claims from that PDF because the linked host was inaccessible from the crawl environment.
